name: ArenaConfirmRequest
description: A confirmation asked for from code rather than from a template, drawn by the ArenaConfirmDialog the consumer renders once at the head of the queue. Every field means what the dialog's member of the same name means; an absent label reaches the dialog absent and the dialog answers it through the locale.

title.description: Names the dialog. Required: asking with a blank title is refused at once.

eyebrow.description: The short kicker above the title.

destructive.description: Whether confirming is the final irreversible step, drawn as the one filled danger surface.

requireText.description: Text the reader must type before the confirming button is enabled.
